statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains in the low band because the final NDX cash close was nearly flat after a substantial rebound from the session low, while current cross-sectional evidence is mixed rather than persistently one-way.
recommendation: Published policy mapping: EA_ON. The next concentrated checkpoint is Wednesday's U.S. cash-open and Employer Costs window, followed by the Apple event; any Tail escalation remains conditional on persistent live repricing with failed repair.
headline: Intraday repair keeps Tail low while oil, yields and geopolitics keep Stress extreme
body: Official NDX data show a 29,548.45 close versus 29,544.16 previously, after a 29,400.70 low and 29,655.73 high. Fresh supplementary context shows most megacaps lower but most tracked semiconductors higher. Brent near $98, a 10-year yield near 4.79% and Middle East escalation keep Stress extreme without establishing a one-way Nasdaq path.

sources.title: Reuters — S&P 500 falls as AI worries hit software makers
Reuters — Oil prices hit six-week high after Houthis attack Saudi sites

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hours, published Tail ranged from 16% to 32%. The peak occurred during the 14:00 UTC cash-open downside extension, then fell below WATCH as the session repaired. Stress remained extreme throughout the latest sequence.
outlookSummary: The base case keeps Tail low overnight and through Europe. WATCH conditions rise into Wednesday's U.S. cash open and the 14:00 UTC Employer Costs release, with a separate WATCH checkpoint at the 17:00 UTC Apple event. Any escalation remains conditional on persistent live repricing and failed repair.

forecast.analysis: Official NDX closed at 29,548.45, nearly flat after rebounding from a 29,400.70 low. No fresher post-close NQ path is available during the maintenance break; the repaired cash path keeps Tail low while oil, yields and geopolitical risk keep Stress extreme.
drivers: NDX closed nearly flat after a roughly 148-point rebound from the session low
No fresh post-close NQ path is available during the futures maintenance break
Oil, Treasury yields and Middle East risk keep macro Stress elevated

news.title: S&P 500 falls as AI worries hit software makers
Oil prices hit six-week high after Houthis attack Saudi sites

forecast.analysis: After futures reopen, low Tail is conditional on two-sided rotation around the repaired U.S. close. A sustained break that holds near an extreme and resists meaningful retracement would challenge this baseline.

Late U.S. evening remains low Tail if reopened futures rotate rather than extend efficiently. Geopolitical headlines would mainly raise Stress unless NQ also holds direction through meaningful counter-moves.
At the Asia handoff, the low-Tail base case assumes orderly price discovery. Risk would rise if an overnight directional move holds near its extreme and repeatedly extends after shallow repairs.
Early Asia remains low Tail if pullbacks and reversals stay meaningful. Cross-asset pressure becomes a stronger Tail amplifier only if it aligns with efficient one-way NQ structure.
Mid-Asia keeps a low-Tail baseline. The principal checkpoint is retracement quality: repeated extension after failed counter-moves would be materially more adverse than headline volatility alone.
drivers: Headline volatility versus persistent price path

forecast.analysis: Later Asia remains low Tail if overnight moves continue to retrace. Holding near an overnight extreme with progressively shallower counter-moves would increase concern before Europe.
The Asia-to-Europe transition stays low Tail if price continues rotating through prior levels. A clean handoff of a one-way overnight move into Europe would be the main adverse conditional path.
Pre-Europe liquidity can magnify short moves, but Tail remains low unless direction becomes efficient and retracements repeatedly fail. Oil and rates remain background Stress amplifiers.

Around the European open, low Tail assumes no reinforcement of a one-way overnight move. Persistent continuation across the regional handoff would be a more meaningful warning than a temporary volatility burst.
European morning Tail stays low if early regional moves show usable retracement. A synchronized move in NQ, yields and volatility would raise the risk of a more efficient directional session.
Mid-European trading remains low Tail while two-sided structure persists. Oil and yields can amplify risk only if NQ begins holding near an extreme and resisting meaningful repair.
drivers: Oil and yields as conditional amplifiers

forecast.analysis: As U.S. participation begins to build, Tail edges higher because gap formation can become more informative. The base case remains non-blocking unless premarket direction becomes persistent with shallow pullbacks.
U.S. premarket risk remains below WATCH if price stays rotational. A larger gap aligned with rates and technology breadth would matter more if retracement attempts also begin failing.

Approaching the main U.S. premarket window, Stress rises ahead of Employer Costs. Tail stays low because the release has not occurred; only a developing persistent gap or one-way structure would justify escalation.
drivers: Employer Costs is still a future checkpoint
Persistent direction required for Tail escalation

forecast.analysis: WATCH conditions begin as cash-open liquidity approaches. Tail rises conditionally if premarket direction aligns with yields and survives meaningful pullbacks; event importance alone remains a Stress input.
drivers: Yield alignment if a directional move develops

forecast.analysis: The 13:00 UTC hour includes the 13:30 cash open. WATCH assumes opening-auction risk; a higher Tail path would require observed continuation, extreme holding and shallow or failed repairs after the open.
drivers: Shallow or failed repairs would be adverse

forecast.analysis: Employer Costs is scheduled for 14:00 UTC. WATCH reflects the release and early cash-session overlap, but the outcome is unknown; blocking risk would require the actual repricing to persist through failed retracements.
drivers: Actual release outcome is unknown before publication
Persistent post-release repricing would be the key Tail test

forecast.analysis: Post-release WATCH remains conditional on an unresolved second leg from the cash open or Employer Costs. Meaningful two-sided repair would weaken the adverse path and support a quick Tail normalization.
By 16:00 UTC, the base case returns to low Tail if the opening and release impulses have repaired. Continued extreme holding with another failed retracement would invalidate that normalization.
drivers: Another failed retracement would invalidate the base case

forecast.analysis: Apple's event is scheduled for 17:00 UTC. WATCH reflects a major technology-catalyst window; the event itself is not Tail evidence, which would require an observed persistent index reaction with failed repair.
drivers: Persistent index reaction would be required for higher Tail

forecast.analysis: The hour after the Apple event remains WATCH while price discovery could continue. Tail stays below the blocking band unless the reaction becomes one-way, holds near an extreme and defeats meaningful retracement.
Later U.S. trading returns to a low-Tail base case if event-driven moves repair and cross-asset signals remain mixed. Persistent late-session extension would be the main conditional invalidation.

Into the final forecast hour, low Tail assumes rotational late-session trade. Power-hour direction matters only if it persists near an extreme with shallow counter-moves rather than normal two-sided movement.
drivers: Shallow counter-moves versus normal two-sided trade

forecastDetail.comment: Final NDX cash data show substantial intraday repair; no fresher post-close NQ path is available during the maintenance break.
Low Tail after the reopen assumes two-sided rotation; sustained extreme holding would challenge the baseline.
Late-evening Tail stays low if retracements remain meaningful; headlines alone primarily affect Stress.
At the Asia handoff, orderly discovery keeps Tail low; repeated extension after shallow repair is the adverse path.
Early Asia remains low Tail if reversals remain meaningful; cross-asset alignment matters only with persistent NQ direction.
Mid-Asia focuses on retracement quality; failed counter-moves would matter more than volatility alone.
